content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The summary describes the complaint, but nothing in it shows that the non-selection claims were investigated. It has no statements from the selecting officials, no explanation of why Complainant was not selected, and no information on who was selected. Without selectee age and qualifications, there is nothing to test the age claim or compare candidates. Reprisal also requires knowledge of the prior EEO activity by the decision-makers, and no one is shown to have been asked about it. The harassment report concerned a coworker and Supervisor 2, and no link to the selecting officials is established. The agency's finding of no discrimination cannot be evaluated from this record, and the missing evidence should be gathered before a merits decision."}
